title: Pau was amazing!
text: Pau was amazing. Such a nice person and so knowledgeable of Barcelona and the Catalan regional. Highly recommend!
author: 503elizabethu

title: A fun evening with Isabel
text: We had a fun walking tour with our guide, Isabel!  She picked us up at our hotel and took us all around the Gothic Quarter of Barcelona.  We had walked La Rambla before... but she took us up little alleys to find the hidden gems along the way!  She also took us to the big market and pointed out some favorite things.  She told us stories, took our photo,  shared a little about her life here in Barcelona, and it felt like a very personal time together as friends. title: Exploring Barcelona with a knowledgeable local
text: Frederick was knowledgeable and easy to be with. The day felt like we were with a friend who was sharing his city with us.

text:

a great personality and really knows Barcelona well. She researches the sites to be

author: CHotko

title: Excellent for solo traveler
text: Alan was an excellent guide. His knowledge was top notch. He showed me all of the cool spots, and gave me great ideas for my solo trip on what to do next. He tailored the experience to things of my interest.  Highly recommended for solo travelers who want to get ideas and see the city (on foot so bring comfy shoes)!
author: Elena_R

title: The best experience to get to know Barcelona!
text:
Alan is a very well-prepared person; he is very kind and patient. I must mention that I traveled with children, and he was always attentive to explain in a way that they could understand, always including them. He is very friendly, and the tour was so natural that it felt like I had known him for years. These are the positive things that are always remembered on trips. I personally recommend him highly. I can assure you that he knows more about Barcelona than the locals themselves!
Thank you very much for sharing your knowledge about Catalunya, Alan! A warm hug from my entire family!
author: 66abrahame

title: Great!
text: Anna was enthusiastic, knowledgeable, kind, and open to exploring our interests. She took us through gothic neighborhood and focused on history, culture, and architecture
author: Sydney_S

title: Johnathan was very casual...
text: Johnathan was very casual and informative! We walked around the districts in a timely manner (10 miles, 20k steps!) seeing the external architecture and hearing stories. Wear your walking shoes, clean your eyeballs, open your ears, take it all in with this tour!
author: Kiera_D

title: We had a great morning...
text: We had a great morning with Federico, he showed us many fascinating parts of Barcelona and taught us about the history of the city. He also gave us great food recommendations!
author: Jenni_C

title: Federico was great!
text: Federico was FANTASTIC! Great guide, so friendly and knowledgeable about the city. Definitely enhanced our experience in our time here. Great restaurant/dining recommendations as well!
